newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM SAYS FARE HIKES PRODUCE MORE REALISTIC PRICES.
newsitem.headline: KLM SAYS FARE HIKES PRODUCE MORE REALISTIC PRICES.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Tuesday its newly-announced fare hikes were aimed at defraying more than just burgeoning fuel costs.
Earlier, the Dutch carrier said that based on International Air Transport Association (IATA) consultations, it had decided to hike its ticket prices by between three and five percent.

"Looking at the tariffs and (the product) which is being offered and the costs involved...we (and other IATA carriers) said it would be more realistic if tariffs were brought up to a slightly higher level," spokesman Peter Wellhuner told Reuters.

He said the decision had come in the wake of an IATA meeting last month in Geneva, where delegates from the world's airlines met to discuss their options in the face of structurally higher costs and falling prices.
Several U.S. and European airlines within the IATA framework had already increased their rates and others had given notice they would do so, he said, but declined to name them.
KLM said in a statement that a fuel surcharge introduced in November to offset spiralling fuel costs would be withdrawn when the tariff hikes were introduced.

The fuel surcharge, also levied by carriers such as British Airways and Lufthansa, has raised the ire of shippers and forwarders, many of whom complain at the summary manner in which they were introduced.
Some forwarders' associations, such as Britain's FTA and France's SNAGFA, have lodged a formal protest and may even be weighing action.
"They may be...but if fuel prices over which we have no control rise exorbitantly -- as they have done -- we too have to make a living," Wellhuner said.

"We were plagued by higher fuel costs for over a year before the surcharge...there have been no complaints about airlines bearing that cost," he said, adding the highly competitive market conditions made it difficult for airlines to announce price-sensitive measures well ahead of time.
He said Lufthansa had also announced it would raise its cargo rates.
